node.title: Re^5: Replace a Hex Value in Column
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I just a have strange error on the exist but output is quiet fine Use of uninitialized value in split at ./dpi.pl line 9, <> line 11. "";;;;;""

That's not an error, just a warning, about the fact that $row->[5] is undef. From the output I suspect you've just got an empty line at the end of your input (line 11, as the message says).
